content:
**Abandoned Mine Shaft 4** is a location in the Ash Heap region of Appalachia. 

The fourth in a series of abandoned mine shafts found throughout the Ash Heap.

The location consists of two buildings and a refinery laid out north to south. The easternmost building has a Cooking Station up at its north end, and two dumpsters are along the eastern wall. The western wall has lockers with a potential armor mod inside and a Weapons Workbench. Inside the building is a Mattress. To the west is a refinery.

In the southwest corner is a larger two-story building. Proceeding through the eastern barn door, straight forward is a staircase, to the left is a Power Armor Station. Further in and on the northernmost wall is a Tinker's Workbench. At the top of the stairs, there is a Safe (Picklock 3) on the right and an Armor Workbench to the left. Turn around, there is a Bed across a walkway. From there, a northern door opens to the top of the refinery.

Abandoned Mine Shaft 4 appears in *Fallout 76*.
